scope: Isolated CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR. The packed 1.0.0 tarball was installed from a local marketplace and answered /router status. It was then disabled, and a v0.8.0 tag checkout was loaded with --plugin-dir. Its SessionStart hook ran; it found the live 0.8.0 gateway on the default port and left it alone, as designed. The same checkout's ensure-gateway started a 0.8.0 gateway on an isolated port, which was then stopped. No model request was sent through the rehearsal gateway; the live Team session that ran this rehearsal used 0.8.0 routing.
steps: npm pack; local marketplace; claude plugin install router@<local-marketplace>

git worktree of tag v0.8.0; claude -p --plugin-dir <checkout>
